query: SELECT m.id, m.senderId, m.recipientId, m.content, u1.name as senderName, u2.name as recipientName FROM messages m LEFT JOIN users u1 ON m.senderId = u1.id LEFT JOIN users u2 ON m.recipientId = u2.id LIMIT 5;
